messages:
leo.marketing: Quick ask — can design take a prioritized visual pack for next week's launch slice? Need compact deliverables: 3 micro-tiles (hero / metric / CTA), 1 simplified latency-vs-cost diagram (SVG), and 2 email header variants. Low-risk A/B options ok. Can you confirm capacity and ETA?

tina.design: Yep, we can do it. Quick q: what are the exact pixel specs for the micro-tiles and email headers, and which variant is highest priority? Also need brand compliance checklist from legal before final.

arjun.pm: Priority order for product: (1) hero micro-tile for social + docs, (2) latency-vs-cost diagram (for webinar slide and blog), (3) metric card for sales one-pager, (4) CTA tile, then email headers. Use the smaller hero first for paid-social.

casey.content: Copy is mostly locked. Two headline variants attached below: 
- V1: "Serving wins: faster, cheaper, reliable inference"
- V2: "Production inference that scales — lower cost, predictable latency"
I'll add alt text and 50-char social copy in the figma comments.

leo.marketing: Figma file with frames + tokens: https://figma.com/file/Abc123/launch-slice (comments enabled). Brand tokens to use: --rw-blue-600, --rw-ink-900, --rw-accent-200. Avoid custom gradients outside brand. For diagram, prefer single-color fills + 2-step drop shadow, export as clean SVG.

tina.design: Got the file. Small technical asks: 
- micro-tile sizes: 1200x630 (hero), 600x600 (metric/cta), email headers: 600x200 and 800x200 (mobile+desktop)
- SVG diagram: use stroke-based axes, separate layers for labels, no rasterized text
- Deliverables: SVGs + optimized PNGs @2x, Figma components with tokens used, and a simple usage doc (one-paragraph).

leo.marketing: Adding legal note — trademarked term "Redwood Serving" should be approved. @tina.design + @arjun.pm loop in legal if needed.

figma-bot: File updated by tina.design — 6 frames added, 3 comments.

tina.design: Quick implementation snippet for the hero gradient if needed in code: ```css
.hero-bg {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rw-blue-600) 0%, rgba(18,20,22,0.00) 100%);
}
```

casey.content: Small copy tweak request: V1 slightly shorter: "Serving wins — faster, cheaper inference". Use V2 as alternate test.

arjun.pm: Timeline check — initial comps by EOD Thursday (1712358200), review on Friday, final export Monday. Is that feasible?

tina.design: EOD Thu for first pass is tight but doable. We'll prioritize hero + diagram first. Will post frames in Figma and tag you.

leo.marketing: Perfect. If legal flags wording, we can fallback to generic phrasing. Thanks team :thumbsup:

tina.design: Checklist I'm tracking: 1) comps (hero, diagram) 2) metric + CTA 3) email headers 4) SVG/PNG exports + alt text 5) Figma components + tokens 6) usage note for comms/legal. I'll update the thread when frames are ready.

leo.marketing: Thanks — looping design owner in calendar invite for Friday review.

figma-bot: Comment added by casey.content on frame "hero-V1" — "alt text + microcopy here".

leo.marketing: Appreciated, team. I'll prep the webinar slide with the diagram once SVG is ready.

tina.design: Noted. Will ping here when first frames are uploaded.
